title: Products Never Ordered
statement:
A shop wants to know which products nobody has ordered yet.

There are three tables:

- `products`: `id`, `name` (unique), and `price`, one row per product
- `orders`: `id`, `customer`, and `placed_on`, one row per order
- `order_items`: `order_id`, `product_id`, and `quantity`, one row for each product in an order

Return two columns, `id` and `name`, for every product that appears in no row of `order_items`. Use `NOT EXISTS` with a subquery that looks for the product's order items. Order the rows by `name` alphabetically.

Expected output:

```text
 id |    name
----+-------------
  6 | Cable Tray
  7 | Footrest
  5 | Monitor Arm
(3 rows)
```
setup:
CREATE TABLE products (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  price NUMERIC(8, 2) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  customer TEXT NOT NULL,
  placed_on DATE NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id),
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);

INSERT INTO products (id, name, price) VALUES
  (1, 'Desk Lamp', 34.99),
  (2, 'Notebook', 4.50),
  (3, 'Standing Desk', 429.00),
  (4, 'Fountain Pen', 24.00),
  (5, 'Monitor Arm', 89.95),
  (6, 'Cable Tray', 19.99),
  (7, 'Footrest', 39.00);

INSERT INTO orders (id, customer, placed_on) VALUES
  (101, 'Lena Fischer', '2026-03-02'),
  (102, 'Marco Rossi', '2026-03-05'),
  (103, 'Lena Fischer', '2026-03-11'),
  (104, 'Sara Ahmed', '2026-03-14');

INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES
  (101, 2, 3),
  (101, 4, 1),
  (102, 3, 1),
  (102, 1, 2),
  (103, 2, 5),
  (104, 1, 1);

----+-------------

hints: `NOT EXISTS (subquery)` is true when the subquery returns no rows at all.
Make the subquery look for order items of the outer product, by comparing `order_items.product_id` with the outer product's `id`.

sql.starter:
SELECT p.id, p.name
FROM products AS p
-- TODO: keep only products that appear in no order item
ORDER BY p.name;
sql.solution:
SELECT p.id, p.name
FROM products AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM order_items AS oi
  WHERE oi.product_id = p.id
)
ORDER BY p.name;
